title: 1972 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Rat
seo_title: 1972 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Rat (15 February – 2 February 1973)
description: 1972 is the Year of the Water Rat (Yang, Ren-zi), from 15 February 1972 to 2 February 1973. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1972.
lead: Born in 1972? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rat, but check the date: the 1972 Water Rat year began on 15 February 1972. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1972: Year of the Water Rat, from 15 February 1972 to 2 February 1973.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1972 was the Year of the Rat. It began with Lunar New Year on 15 February 1972 and ended on 2 February 1973, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1972 ends in 2, which makes it a Water year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1972 is a Ren-zi year. The same Water Rat combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1912 before it and 2032 after it.
Lunar New Year 1972 fell on 15 February 1972, so everyone born in January 1972, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Pig.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rat guide describes the sign like this: “Quick-witted, resourceful, and sociable. Rats are natural problem-solvers who notice opportunities others miss.” The usual watch-out: “Can be restless or overly cautious with money and trust.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Rat page.
Careers often linked with the Rat: business, writing, research, trading.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1972
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rat's best matches are the Dragon, Monkey and Ox, and its clash sign is the Horse, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rat, it sits directly opposite the Horse, so 2026 is its clash year: a year to stay flexible and check plans twice.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rat, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rat years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1948 (Earth Rat); 1960 (Metal Rat); 1984 (Wood Rat); 1996 (Fire Rat). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1972 is the Year of the Rat, a Yang Water Rat year (Ren-zi).
When does the 1972 Year of the Rat start and end?
It starts on 15 February 1972 and ends on 2 February 1973.
I was born in January 1972. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Pig: Lunar New Year 1972 was on 15 February 1972, so all of January 1972 belongs to the Pig year.
Water. 1972 ends in 2, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Rat compatible with?
Traditionally the Dragon, Monkey and Ox. The Rat's clash sign is the Horse.
